title: Telnyx Settings: Connect, Noise Suppression and Answering Machine Detection | CrestApps for Orchard Core
description:
Telnyx is a cloud phone provider. This video shows how the Telnyx tab of the telephony settings in CrestApps for Orchard Core connects the platform to a Telnyx account, and what you can tune once it is connected: noise suppression, answering machine detection, the speaking voice and more. The demo site has no Telnyx account, so the tab is shown before connecting and the rest is described.

In this video:
• What the Telnyx tab does
• Enabling Telnyx and the API key
• After you connect: caller id and webhook key
• Noise suppression, answering machine detection, text-to-speech
• Advanced settings
